scope: (1) welder_postings: 9 plants, their plants.csv welder_postings field and all 36 welder_postings evidence rows, checked against each company board today; (2) products_rows: the 25 stated battery products rows whose source is a job posting.
decision_rule: R3-I's rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting through a shared city, misdates a posting, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked first); Confirmed otherwise. Unreachable only if the source cannot be reached at all. Added for this scope: a row whose value is fully carried by the cited page but whose quote is shorter than the value is confirmed with the fuller quote in the note (Wedlake, Power Pool Plus). A posting's own duty or role-summary text located at a site is site work even when the same duty text is templated across the company's sites (Tomball x3, Yancey x4, Fidelity Ocala Plants 1-2, EK Madison and Fall River: confirmed at face value, flagged for one coordinator ruling); it is company-level when the text is a company About/Overview paragraph, or when the role's scope is a division-wide system (Cordele QC Manager: QMS 'for Yancey Engineered Solutions (YES), a division'). Displayed UKG 'Posted on' dates written as 'listed' are correct; the raw PostedDate is reported where it differs.
error_rate_note: Unit = one evidence row (36 welder_postings rows + 25 products rows = 61); the 9 plants.csv welder_postings fields were checked against the boards and are carried as plants_csv_value on the corrected row (Hennig), not counted separately. 4/61 = 6.6%. Per distinct claim_id: 4/31 = 12.9%. Strict reading (also counting the two short quotes, Wedlake and Power Pool Plus, and the GPC mixed-tag row as corrections): 7/61 = 11.5%. Plants.csv fields alone: 1/9 corrected (Hennig count and address premise); Union's field omits two listed-only CWI roles (field note, not counted). By scope: welder_postings 1/36 = 2.8%; products 3/25 = 12.0%. Every quote whose page was fetched was found (visible text, rendered UKG page, or raw source); 0 unreachable.
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (3: Tesla Lathrop products, EK Madison products, Yancey Cordele QC Manager products) - three patterns: (a) a posting's text placed at the site when the posting shows a wider scope (a QC Manager's division-wide QMS at Cordele), (b) clauses added that the page does not carry ('at Madison', 'fuel' tanks for EK Madison), (c) desirable candidate knowledge written as the site's process (Tesla Lathrop). SWEEP: for every stated products and production_type row sourced from a job posting at a multi-site parent, check whether the posting's scope is a division or several plants (division QMS, 'all locations', travel between plants) and whether each clause of the value is on the page; retag inferred company-level or trim, and re-derive confidence. Also rule once on templated duty text shared word for word across sites (Tomball, Yancey, Fidelity, EK).

score_problems.why: RULING. Yancey's own board carries WELDE005744 with raw PostedDate 2026-06-30 (displayed 'Posted on November 2, 2026' is a re-post stamp; UpdatedDate 2026-11-11); the requisition number sits between 005616 (raw 2026-05-27) and 006145 (raw 2026-10-06), so the June date is consistent. As written (posting dates from the company's own board: raw PostedDate), the posting has been open 140 days: 60+ days earns 20, total 71 -> 79 (High either way). Counter-case for keeping 12: Yancey re-stamps its welder requisitions (same pattern at Barnesville 004838 since 2025-10-20 and Batesville 005616), which looks like a standing ad, and Cordele is pre-production (refurbishment), so a June requisition for a plant not yet producing reads as pipeline hiring; the standing-ad rule says never 60+ days when the date shows a standing ad. The Cat dealer board (which matched Griffin's raw date) does not list a Cordele Welder, and its own job IDs also show re-stamps (Barnesville jobs 4656/4657 'posted' 2026-10-27), so it cannot settle this. This reopens the run-log ruling 'Cordele labor stays 12' (battery profiling, profiler E) on a fact not in the ledger then (the raw PostedDate of WELDE005744). Coordinator call; not counted as a correction. Also: Cordele's score_labor reasoning still says 'posted 2026-11-02' (should be 'listed').

Part mix 15 cites p-yancey-cordele-ga:production_type, whose only row is the QC Manager line now corrected to division-level (inferred). Part mix 15 stands on the c-yancey company-level ruling, which earns points but no confidence. The c-yancey line in ledger/audit/no-confidence-claims.csv names Griffin, Barnesville and Batesville only: extend it to Cordele or add p-yancey-cordele-ga:production_type. Total 71 unchanged.

RULING on the basis, not the points (count corrected 7 -> 8; labor 20 holds on the count). Consultation 15 scored Hennig without the campus rule because the counted roles were said to sit at a board location whose address is the record's. Today the counted roles carry no street address (ZIP 61115 only); Paylocity location IDs are per job, and the 'Hennig Power' label carries three addresses. So the tie is a city-only fact and needs the shared-city/campus rule. Hennig's other Machesney Park production site is 9900/9904 N Alpine Rd, which ECHO names 'HENNIG ENCLOSURE SYSTEMS' (enclosure fabrication, the same production as 4950 Marlin Dr, NAICS 332322). Distance from one source, re-fetched 2026-11-17: ECHO DFR 110054367788 / 110070285900 (9904 N Alpine Rd, 42.3722, -89.02591) to 110071442471 (4950 Marlin Dr, 42.378992, -89.021612) = 0.83 km, inside the ~1 km campus limit; the ledger's :address row notes OpenStreetMap Hennig footprints on N Alpine Rd agreeing with ECHO. The Census geocoder interpolates 9904 N Alpine Rd 1.61 km away, which the ledger row already discounts. On ECHO, the campus rule is met: labor 20 stands, confidence unchanged; the :welder_postings reasoning should cite the campus rule instead of the address premise, and for consistency the two Alpine Rd Tank Welders would also count (no point change). If the coordinator prefers the Census distance, the attribution is inferred and labor is 0: total 72 -> 52 (Medium), confidence 5 -> 4.
